    "Superior task tracking and project visibility compared to previous tools.",
    "Intuitive interface that simplifies team collaboration and project organization.",
    "Flexible structure that adapts well to various consulting project needs."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Can become expensive for larger teams requiring advanced features.",
    "Initial setup and customization for complex workflows required a time investment.",
    "Reporting capabilities, while good, sometimes lacked depth for specific client-facing metrics."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Dev Web professional likely found Asana to be a significant upgrade for organizing projects and tasks, especially coming from Zoho Projects. Its robust functionality and intuitive design effectively streamlined their team's workflow within the management consulting environment. While the cost and initial setup posed minor challenges, the benefits in project visibility and collaboration made it a valuable tool for their team over the past one to two years."
